newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Tranz Rail says no decision on ferry port.
newsitem.headline: Tranz Rail says no decision on ferry port.

text.p: New Zealand's Tranz Rail Ltd said on Tuesday it had not made a decision yet on whether to relocate its South Island ferry terminal from Picton to Clifford Bay.
"While Clifford Bay is our preferred location, we have not yet ruled out upgrading the current facilities at Picton," Managing Director Francis Small said in a statement.

Tranz Rail applied for resource consents last month to develop a port and associated facilities at Clifford Bay in Marlborough, and Small said it would make its decision once this process was completed. Hearings are expected later this year.

Tranz Rail operates New Zealand's railway network and runs ferries between the North and South Islands. Its major shareholders are Wisconsin Central Transportation Corp, private equity firm Berkshire Partners, Pacific Rail (a subsidiary of Fay, Richwhite and Co) and David Lloyd Investments. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
